steps: Deployed the program to devnet (upgrade authority is the lab wallet)
initialize marketplace 4yWx7jjP… with authority = lab wallet, total_bounties=0
Fetched marketplace: authority is the lab wallet, total_bounties=0
Created a lab SPL mint BJMSdujx… (6 decimals) and minted 1000 tokens to the lab ATA J3weMnAc…
create_bounty campus-scout bounty, reward=100 tokens (bounty 4VEXSpTX…, escrow DcPAPUE9…)
claim_bounty by the lab wallet (same wallet as creator)
submit_completion with a lab delivery URL
evidence.functional_evidence: initialize landed; create_bounty escrowed 100 tokens of mint BJMSdujxakjx7qypwfaFCnbkMTNPEYVWTTqnR9eJRL4D; claim_bounty, submit_completion and approve_completion completed bounty 4VEXSpTXBHejeH3coEig2bto2Dpx2XQHK3mmX7JPDzzN with agent total_earned=95000000; InvalidReward rejected a zero reward.
evidence.ui_check: The hosted page is the generic IDL console (connect Phantom or Solflare on devnet). It was not driven in headless Chromium in this run; the bounty lifecycle was sent with the lab wallet through the IDL client in tests/devnet/forge-agent-bounty.mjs.

limitations: reject_completion was not exercised. approve_completion pays 95% of the reward to the agent and leaves the 5% platform fee in the escrow token account (there is no treasury transfer). The lab wallet was both creator and agent.
